customManagers.description: Crate-installed tools the workflows and xtask pin; xtask's `pins_match_ci` test keeps the copies equal

packageRules.description: Each cargo-public-api release reads a range of rustdoc JSON formats, so it bumps by hand with the nightly in xtask/src/gates.rs
Topcoat and Toasty bump as one grouped set, the topcoat CLI with them
argon2 + password-hash bump as one coupled set, never separately
hkdf, hmac, sha1 + sha2 bump as one coupled set, never separately: they all build on digest, and a mix of digest versions does not compile
The vendored TipTap bundle's packages bump as one set; the PR fails the tiptap.js guard until `cargo xtask vendor-tiptap` rebuilds the bundle on its branch
